consumer: The PICKUP input loop in pick_up_from_items: ctxt.handle_input() in src/pickup.cpp asks the player, interactively, which ground items to mark and confirm for pickup.
scope: items reachable nearby (the ground-item stack of in-range tiles via map::i_at), NOT the avatar's own carried items
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items — builds input_context("PICKUP"), registers UP/DOWN/RIGHT/CONFIRM/QUIT, and runs a redraw/input loop calling ctxt.handle_input() to mark selections and finalize on CONFIRM; this is the interactive menu that performs the choosing, not the snapshot exporters.
divergence: Two items A and B lie in the ground pile; the player selects only A. A correct B-class drive picks up A and leaves B on the ground; a wrong answer (e.g. defaulting to grab-all from the i_at stack, or reading carried_items instead) would pick up both or pick up nothing, diverging from the player's interactive selection.
